title: Timeframe Mappings Configuration
description: Configuration for parsing timeframe expressions (QR2604, FY26, H1/26) from Area Paths and mapping them to date ranges. Used for fallback dates and policy validation.

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year configuration for FY-prefixed timeframes

offsetMonths.description: Month offset from calendar year start. Use -3 for fiscal year starting in October (FY26 = Oct 2025 - Sep 2026)

pattern.description: Regex pattern for fiscal year expressions. Must include named group 'year'. Optional group 'quarter' for FY quarters.

patterns.description: List of timeframe patterns to recognize

regex.description: Regex pattern with named groups. Common groups: year, quarter, half, month

quarterToMonths.description: Mapping of quarter number to start/end months

halfToMonths.description: Mapping of half-year number to start/end months

pathExtraction.description: Configuration for extracting timeframes from Area/Iteration paths

areaPathPatterns.description: Regex patterns to extract timeframe from Area Path. Must include named group 'timeframe'.

iterationPathPatterns.description: Regex patterns to extract timeframe from Iteration Path. Must include named group 'timeframe'.

useFieldMappings.description: Whether to use existing field mapping configuration for date field discovery

fallbackFields.description: Fallback field names if not found in field mappings

targetDate.description: Field names to check for target date (in priority order)

startDate.description: Field names to check for start date (in priority order)

endDate.description: Field names to check for end/finish date (in priority order)
